 Chelsea team news vs PSG: Kadeisha Buchanan on bench as Melvine Malard misses out
 Nathalie Björn captains Chelsea against PSG at Plough Lane. Kadeisha Buchanan and Giulia Dragoni are on the bench, with Aggie Beever-Jones starting in place of Melvine Malard.
 By James Chettle Verified Human Published 18 Nov 2026, 19:08 Live for 2 hours Read me this article 2 min G Add as preferred source 
 Kadeisha Buchanan is on the bench for Chelsea ’s Women’s Champions League match against Paris Saint-Germain on Wednesday night. Aggie Beever-Jones starts in place of Melvine Malard, who misses out with a hamstring injury.
 Buchanan and Malard both went off before half-time in Saturday’s 1-0 win over Manchester City at Stamford Bridge, which took Chelsea top of the Women’s Super League . Nathalie Björn captains the side at Plough Lane, where the match kicks off at 8pm GMT.
 ? – ? Premier League Predictor Predict this matchweek’s scores. Free to play. Play now 
 Chelsea team news: Buchanan on bench, Malard out
 “Kadeisha is fine after the weekend, she is available for the game tomorrow. She could train normally today,” Sonia Bompastor said in her pre-match team update . Björn and Veerle Buurman come into the starting XI in place of Lucy Bronze and Buchanan.
 Malard will miss both of Chelsea’s remaining games before the international break. Bompastor said the club would reassess her hamstring during the break. Giulia Dragoni returns to the bench, while Manaka Matsukubo is close to resuming full training.
 Lauren James will also miss the rest of this block of fixtures. Naomi Girma is continuing her rehabilitation and Bompastor expects her back after the break.

 Chelsea and PSG starting XIs
 Chelsea : Hampton, Carpenter, Björn (c), Buurman, McCabe, Kaptein, Walsh, Potter, Baltimore, Beever-Jones, Thompson.
 Chelsea substitutes: Peng, Spencer, Buchanan, Las, Cuthbert, Nüsken, Dragoni, Brown, Hamano. UEFA also lists Lucy Bronze among the substitutes.
 PSG : Kiedrzynek, Isabela, Mbock Bathy (c), Samoura, Elimbi Gilbert, Echegini, Groenen, Østerås, Le Guilly, Feller, Kanjinga.
 PSG threats: Naomie Feller and a strong spell after the hour
 Naomie Feller attempted 25 dribbles across the first four matchdays, more than any other PSG player, according to the French club’s match preview . Four of PSG’s eight goals came between the 61st and 75th minutes. They did not concede in that period.
 PSG took a point on their last trip to England, when Tara Elimbi Gilbert’s late equaliser earned a draw at Manchester City .
 Chelsea’s Champions League form
 Chelsea took eight points from their opening four games without conceding a goal. They had two goals ruled out in their most recent European fixture, a 0-0 draw at Häcken .
 UK viewers can watch the game on Disney+. Our Chelsea vs PSG viewing guide has the match details.
